stations.title: Screen reader
stations.text: Reads the HTML, not the pixels.
stations.note: Every part is a plain box.

captions: Marguerite runs the knitting circle at Quillmoor Library and wants to find it on the page.
Her screen reader hears the page as one long paragraph, so the event is lost.
You give the HTML its parts, headings and a list, in three tasks.
Now she can jump straight to the events and to Knit and natter.
Same page, same look. It now says what each part is.
